decision: The exact acknowledged deletion and fresh reconciled resource inventory are sufficient for a distinct replacement under the existing budget/one-server authority. Awaiting the Fleet enum deleted is not necessary for non-overlap, but pending Fleet cleanup must remain pending and be reconciled later. This is not permission to replay an uncertain creation or relax the remaining launch controls.
facts: DeleteFleets acknowledged this exact Fleet once in SuccessfulFleetDeletions; no unsuccessful entries.
Fresh DescribeFleets still deleted_terminating, but fulfilled on-demand and total capacity both0; request type,target1,ReplaceUnhealthyInstances=false.
DescribeFleetInstances has no active instances. Full regional DescribeInstances includes exactly the known instance explicitly terminated, not merely absent or NotFound; exact Fleet tag agrees.
Full regional DescribeVolumes is empty. Root records default AWS CLI automatic pagination and no inventory truncation.
Known instance termination reason is Client.InstanceInitiatedShutdown; no workloads/private transfer began. This evidence does not independently prove the exact startup failure line.
reasoning: AWS DeleteFleets API explicitly states successful deletion prevents new instance launches. Its documented transition when terminating instances is deleted_terminating, so that enum is not evidence the request can still launch.
AWS Fleet-state description reserves deleted for fully resolved terminal resource accounting. Keep raw deleted_terminating; do not relabel as deleted or call the cleanup gate passed.

AWS API is eventually consistent. Here non-overlap rests on positive exact-instance terminated state plus later full inventory and successful deletion guarantee, rather than on one empty inventory or missing ID alone. Delayed Fleet convergence is a plausible explanation, not an observed internal AWS cause.
replacementConditions: Use a fresh unique intent/client token for the reviewed corrected AMI campaign; never reuse/replay the first launch intent.
Keep first-host charges and all subsequent liabilities inside the same50USD reservation and cumulative300USD ceiling; exact reconciliation belongs to lead ledger.
Keep no-overlap resource checks, unchanged expiry/timers/termination/disk/IMDS/job isolation and all launch prerequisites. No private work until actual controls pass.
Preserve pending Fleet accounting record and later obtain terminal readback; no repeated DeleteFleets required solely to force eventual convergence.
